note: Custom price alerts checked by the hourly scan. Trendlines: two points (date, price) extended in a straight line; Telegram once a week when price reaches the line and on a weekly close through it. Levels: a flat price, exact (the day's high/low must reach it); Telegram once a week when price reaches it and on a daily close through it.
